Tuesday's question: every activity has positive float. Is there still a critical path?

The answer is C. Identify the longest path.

Why:
• The critical path is the longest chain of activities to the finish. It exists even when nothing shows zero float.
• The 25 days come from the Finish On or Before constraint on the contract milestone. That is margin against the contract date, not proof that nothing is critical.
• Removing the constraint (B) or adding Mandatory Finish constraints (D) changes the numbers, not the facts.

On a real update I would report both: the longest path, and the margin to the contract date.

Next question next week. Which topic should it cover: earned value, delay analysis or resource loading?
